title: Privacy Policy - Chibu: Kids Chores & Rewards
content:
# Chibu Privacy Policy

**Effective date: 18 June 2026**

---

## Overview

Chibu ("we", "us", or "the app") is a family chore-and-rewards organiser for parents and their children. The core idea is simple and wholesome: a child completes a chore, earns points, and unlocks a reward or screen time that the parent has chosen. This Privacy Policy explains what information Chibu collects, how it is used, where it is stored, and the rights you have as a parent or guardian.

We have built Chibu around a single privacy promise: **your family's data stays in your own private Apple iCloud account. We never see it, we never sell it, and there are no third-party trackers, advertisers, or analytics companies involved.**

---

## Who We Collect Data From

Chibu is designed to be used by a parent or legal guardian together with their children, including children under 13. All data entry — children's names, avatars, chores, rewards, and any optional photos or location — is set up and controlled by the parent or guardian.

We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children, and we do not require a child to create an account, provide an email address, or sign in. A child simply uses the family device the parent has set up.

If you are a parent or guardian and believe a child has provided personal information in a way you did not intend, please contact us at **azimjondevuz@gmail.com** and we will help you remove it.

---

## What Information We Collect

Chibu only ever holds the information you choose to enter. Depending on the features you use, this may include:

- **Child profile** — a display name or nickname you choose, an avatar emoji, and a colour theme.
- **Child profile photo** _(optional)_ — if you add a photo for a child, it is stored in your family's private iCloud and synced to your other family devices. It is never uploaded to us or any third party.
- **Chores** — chore titles, point values, schedules, and completion records.
- **Photo proof of a completed chore** _(optional)_ — if you enable photo proof, the photo a child submits to show a chore is done is stored in your private iCloud only.
- **Rewards** — reward titles, their point cost, and redemption history.
- **Points and streaks** — points balances, streak counters, and progress.
- **Screen-time settings** _(optional)_ — if you use Apple Screen Time features, the apps you choose for a child to unlock with earned points are managed entirely by Apple's on-device Screen Time system.
- **Location** _(optional, and only with explicit permission)_ — if you turn on the location feature, the child's device location is used to show a map pin and to trigger location-based rewards (for example, "arrived home"). Location is stored only in your private iCloud and is **never** sent to our servers.

We do **not** collect: your email address, phone number, contacts, government IDs, web browsing history, advertising identifiers, or behavioural analytics of any kind.

---

## The Child Is Always Aware (No Covert Monitoring)

Chibu is a parental-control and family-motivation app — **not** covert surveillance or "stalkerware". When monitoring or location features are switched on, the child using the device can see that they are active. We deliberately do not offer any hidden, disguised, or secret tracking mode. Location and screen-time features are visible in the app and rely on the device's own system permission prompts, which the user must approve.

---

## How Your Data Is Stored

All family data is stored exclusively in your family's private Apple iCloud account using Apple's CloudKit framework (the private database). This means:

- Data lives in **iCloud** — Apple's private, encrypted cloud storage — not on any server we own or operate.
- We, the developers of Chibu, have **no access** to your family's data at any time. We cannot read your children's names, photos, chores, points, or location.
- Data is protected by Apple's iCloud security, including end-to-end encryption for private databases where your account supports it (such as Advanced Data Protection).
- Syncing only happens between your own devices and the family members you have invited, all within Apple's Family Sharing and iCloud system.

If you do not have iCloud enabled, your data is stored locally on your device only and is not synced anywhere.

---

## Apple Screen Time — Not MDM

Where Chibu offers screen-time features, it uses **Apple's official Screen Time framework** (Family Controls / Managed Settings / Device Activity). Chibu does **not** use Mobile Device Management (MDM) profiles, VPNs, or any technology that gives us access to your child's apps, messages, web traffic, or device data. App and screen-time choices are processed on the device by Apple's own system; we never receive that information.

---

## Third-Party Services

Chibu relies on Apple and first-party services only:

- **Apple CloudKit** — private iCloud storage and family sync.
- **Apple Screen Time (Family Controls / Managed Settings / Device Activity)** — optional on-device app and screen-time management.
- **Apple StoreKit** — in-app purchase processing for the optional Chibu Plus subscription.

We do **not** use any third-party analytics SDKs, advertising networks, crash-reporting services, marketing tools, or social-media trackers. No data is shared with, sold to, rented to, or processed by any company other than Apple.

---

## No Advertising, No Tracking, No Data Selling

Chibu contains no advertisements. We do not track users for advertising, use cross-app tracking identifiers, build user profiles, or share data with data brokers. We never sell or rent your data — not your information, and certainly not your children's. The app shows no behavioural, retargeting, or interest-based ads of any kind.

---

## In-App Purchases

Chibu offers an optional **Chibu Plus** subscription and a one-time lifetime purchase, processed entirely through Apple's App Store. Purchase records are managed by Apple and are governed by Apple's own privacy policy (apple.com/privacy). We receive only a confirmation that a valid purchase is active — never your payment-card details. See `SUBSCRIPTION_TERMS.md` for full subscription terms.

---

## Verifiable Parental Consent (COPPA)

Because Chibu is set up and operated by a parent or guardian on their own device, and all data stays in that family's private iCloud account, the parent is in direct control of every piece of information at all times.

Before any optional feature that involves a child's photo or location can be used, the parent must:

1. Set up the app as a parent or guardian, and
2. Grant the relevant device permission through Apple's own system prompt (for example, the camera, photo library, or location permission).

This combination — a parent operating the app on their device and explicitly approving each system permission — provides verifiable parental consent for the limited information Chibu holds. No information about a child is ever transmitted to us.

---

## Your Parental Rights

Under the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), the UK GDPR, the EU GDPR, and similar laws, parents and guardians have the right to:

- **Review** the personal information held about their child.
- **Delete** their child's information.
- **Refuse** further collection or use of their child's information.

Because everything is stored in your own iCloud account, you can exercise these rights at any time, instantly:

- **To review information about a child:** open Chibu → Family → select the child.
- **To delete an individual child's records:** open Chibu → Family → select the child → Delete.
- **To delete all family data:** open Chibu → Settings → Delete All Data. This permanently removes all children, chores, rewards, completions, photos, and history from the device and your iCloud.
- **To remove everything from iCloud entirely:** delete the app, then remove "Chibu" from iCloud in Settings → [Your Name] → iCloud → Manage Account Storage.
- **To stop optional features:** turn off the location or screen-time feature in the app at any time, or revoke the relevant permission in your device's Settings.

For any question or request, email **azimjondevuz@gmail.com** and we will respond promptly.

---

## Data Retention

Your data is kept for as long as you use Chibu. When you delete the app, local data is removed from your device. iCloud data remains in your iCloud account until you delete it manually using the steps above. We keep no copies of your data anywhere else, because we never hold it in the first place.

---

## International Users

Chibu is available worldwide. Wherever you are, your data is stored in your own Apple iCloud account and handled by Apple under Apple's privacy practices. We do not move, mirror, or process your data on any infrastructure of our own.

---

## Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the effective date at the top of this document. We encourage you to review this policy periodically. Your continued use of the app after a change takes effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

---

## Contact Us

If you have any question about this Privacy Policy, your data, or your rights as a parent or guardian, please contact us:

**Email:** azimjondevuz@gmail.com

Chibu contains no advertisements. We do not track users for advertising, use cross-app tracking identifiers, build user profiles, or share data with data brokers. We never sell or rent your data — not your information, and certainly not your children's. The app shows no behavioural, retargeting, or interest-based ads of any kind.

---

## In-App Purchases

Chibu offers an optional **Chibu Plus** subscription and a one-time lifetime purchase, processed entirely through Apple's App Store. Purchase records are managed by Apple and are governed by Apple's own privacy policy (apple.com/privacy). We receive only a confirmation that a valid purchase is active — never your payment-card details. See `SUBSCRIPTION_TERMS.md` for full subscription terms.

---

## Verifiable Parental Consent (COPPA)

Because Chibu is set up and operated by a parent or guardian on their own device, and all data stays in that family's private iCloud account, the parent is in direct control of every piece of information at all times.

Before any optional feature that involves a child's photo or location can be used, the parent must:

1. Set up the app as a parent or guardian, and
2. Grant the relevant device permission through Apple's own system prompt (for example, the camera, photo library, or location permission).

---

## Your Parental Rights

Under the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), the UK GDPR, the EU GDPR, and similar laws, parents and guardians have the right to:

- **Review** the personal information held about their child.
- **Delete** their child's information.
- **Refuse** further collection or use of their child's information.

Because everything is stored in your own iCloud account, you can exercise these rights at any time, instantly:

- **To review information about a child:** open Chibu → Family → select the child.
- **To delete an individual child's records:** open Chibu → Family → select the child → Delete.
- **To delete all family data:** open Chibu → Settings → Delete All Data. This permanently removes all children, chores, rewards, completions, photos, and history from the device and your iCloud.
- **To remove everything from iCloud entirely:** delete the app, then remove "Chibu" from iCloud in Settings → [Your Name] → iCloud → Manage Account Storage.
- **To stop optional features:** turn off the location or screen-time feature in the app at any time, or revoke the relevant permission in your device's Settings.

For any question or request, email **azimjondevuz@gmail.com** and we will respond promptly.

---

## Data Retention

Your data is kept for as long as you use Chibu. When you delete the app, local data is removed from your device. iCloud data remains in your iCloud account until you delete it manually using the steps above. We keep no copies of your data anywhere else, because we never hold it in the first place.

---

## International Users

Chibu is available worldwide. Wherever you are, your data is stored in your own Apple iCloud account and handled by Apple under Apple's privacy practices. We do not move, mirror, or process your data on any infrastructure of our own.

---

## Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the effective date at the top of this document. We encourage you to review this policy periodically. Your continued use of the app after a change takes effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

---

## Interpretation and Definitions

### Interpretation
Words with the initial capital letter have meanings defined under the following conditions. The following definitions shall have the same meaning regardless of whether they appear in singular or plural.

### Definitions

*   **Application** means the software program provided by the Company named CleanerKit.
*   **Company** (referred to as either "the Company", "We", "Us", or "Our" in this Agreement) refers to ZBEKZ GROUP.

## Clarifications in the Application
The Company disclaims any liability for any ambiguities that may arise during the use of the Application and does not accept any responsibility.

## Collection and Use of Your Personal Data

#### Usage Data
Usage Data is collected automatically when using the Service.

When You access the Service through a mobile device, We may automatically collect certain information, including but not limited to, the type of mobile device you use, your unique device identifier, the IP address of your mobile device, the mobile operating system, the type of mobile Internet browser you use, unique device identifiers, and other diagnostic data.

We may also collect information that your browser sends whenever you visit our Service or when you access the Service through a mobile device.

#### Device Information and Analytics
We collect device information and usage analytics to improve the performance and functionality of the Application. This includes:

*   Device type, model, and operating system version
*   App usage statistics and feature interactions
*   Performance metrics and crash reports

#### Data Used with Your Consent
When using our Application, we may use the following data with Your consent to provide the features of the Application:

*   Permission to access photos (for cleaning and organization features)
*   Permission to access contacts (for contact management features)

**Important:** We do not collect or store your photos or contacts. These permissions are used solely to provide the cleaning and organization features within the Application. All processing happens locally on your device.

### Storage of Your Data

The Company takes all necessary measures to ensure that Your data is secure and processed in accordance with this Privacy Policy. This includes ensuring the security of Your data and other personal information to an adequate degree, including protection against unauthorized access.

#### Data Retention
We will retain your Personal Data only for as long as necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We will retain and use your data to the extent necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our policies.

#### Other Legal Requirements
The Company may disclose Your personal data where required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities (e.g., a court or a government agency).

*   Compliance with legal obligations
*   Protection and defense of the Company's rights
*   Prevention or investigation of potential misconduct related to the Service
*   Protection of the personal safety of users or the public
*   Protection against legal liability

### Security of Your Data
The security of Your Personal Data is important to Us, but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. We strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect Your Personal Data, but we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

## Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post the new Privacy Policy on this page.

We will notify You by email or a prominent notice on our Service before any changes become effective and update the "Last Updated" at the top of this Privacy Policy.

We advise you to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. Changes to this Privacy Policy will be effective when posted on this page.

# Privacy Policy for DocScan Easy PDF

**Last Updated:** February 22, 2026

## 1. Introduction
Welcome to **DocScan Easy PDF** ("we," "our," or "us"). We are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information when you use our mobile application.

## 2. Data Collection and Usage
**DocScan Easy PDF is designed with privacy as a priority.**

### 2.1. No Personal Data Collection
We do not collect, store, or share any personal identification information (PII) such as your name, email address, phone number, or location data. 

### 2.2. Local Processing
All scanning, document editing, and PDF generation operations happen entirely locally on your device. Specifically:
- **Camera Data:** The camera is used solely to scan documents, receipts, and pages in real-time. We do not record or upload images, scanned documents, or video feeds to any server.
- **Document Storage:** Your scanned documents, extracted text (OCR), signatures, and locally saved PDFs are stored only on your device. We do not have access to your personal documents.

### 2.3. Third-Party Services
We may use standard Apple services (like iCloud) if you choose to sync your data or make backups, which are governed by Apple's own privacy policies.

## 3. Permissions
The app requests the following permissions to function:
- **Camera:** Required to scan documents and pages. Use of the camera is strictly local and for real-time scanning.
- **Photo Library:** Required only if you choose to import existing photos as documents or save generated PDFs and images to your gallery.

## 4. Children's Privacy
Our Service does not address anyone under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 13.

## 5. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Thus, you are advised to review this page periodically for any changes. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.

## 6. Contact Us
If you have any questions or suggestions about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us at:
**azimjondevuz@gmail.com**

title: Privacy Policy - Fleet Transfer
content:
# Privacy Policy

**FleetDownloader**

_Last updated: 26 May 2026_

FleetDownloader (the "App") is a macOS download manager developed by **Azimjon Abdurasulov** (the "Developer", "we", "us"). This Privacy Policy explains what information the App handles and how your privacy is protected.

## Summary

**FleetDownloader does not collect, transmit, or sell any personal data.** The App has no user accounts, no backend server, and no analytics or tracking. Everything the App stores stays on your own Mac.

## 1. Information We Do **Not** Collect

We do not collect, receive, or have access to any of the following:

- Personal information (name, email, address, phone number)
- Account credentials (the App has no sign-in)
- Usage analytics, telemetry, or crash reports sent to us
- Advertising identifiers or tracking data
- Your download history or the contents of your downloads

The App contains **no third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking SDKs**.

## 2. Information Stored Locally on Your Device

To function, the App stores the following **only on your Mac**, inside its sandboxed application container. This data never leaves your device and is never sent to us or any third party:

- **Download records** — URLs you add, file names, sizes, progress, status, and timestamps (stored in a local SQLite database so downloads can resume after a restart).
- **Settings** — your preferences such as default save folder, connection count, speed limits, theme, retry options, and per-host profiles.
- **Connection details you enter** — custom HTTP headers, cookies, referer, user-agent, and proxy configuration (including any proxy username/password). These are stored locally and used solely to perform the downloads you request.
- **Window state** — window size and position, so the App reopens the way you left it.

You can delete all of this at any time by removing the App and its data, or by using the in-App "Reset to defaults" option.

## 3. Clipboard Access

The App includes an optional **Clipboard Monitor** that reads copied text to detect downloadable links and offer to add them. This happens **entirely on your device**:

- Clipboard contents are processed locally and never transmitted anywhere.
- Non-URL clipboard content is ignored and not stored.
- You can disable the Clipboard Monitor at any time in **Settings → Clipboard & Hotkey**.

## 4. Network Connections

The App is a download manager, so it makes outbound network connections — but **only to destinations you choose**:

- It connects to the URLs you add in order to download the requested files.
- If you configure a proxy, traffic is routed through that proxy as you instructed.
- The App does **not** connect to any server operated by the Developer. There is no "phone home" behavior.

## 5. Permissions the App Requests

Under the macOS App Sandbox, the App requests the minimum permissions needed to work:

| Permission | Why |
|---|---|
| Outgoing network connections | To download the files you request |
| Downloads folder (read/write) | Default save location for your downloads |
| User-selected folders (read/write) | To save downloads to folders you pick |
| Clipboard (read) | Optional link detection (can be disabled) |
| Notifications | To tell you when a download finishes |

The App does **not** request access to your camera, microphone, location, contacts, photos, or any other personal data.

## 6. Children's Privacy

The App is a general-purpose utility and is not directed at children. Because we collect no personal data from anyone, we do not knowingly collect any information from children.

## 7. Data Security

Because all data stays on your device within the macOS sandbox, your information is protected by macOS's built-in security and the file-system protections of your Mac. We recommend keeping macOS up to date and using full-disk encryption (FileVault).

## 8. Your Rights

Since we do not collect or hold any of your personal data, there is nothing for us to access, correct, export, or delete on our side. You remain in full control of all App data on your own device. Privacy rights under regulations such as the GDPR (EU/EEA) and CCPA (California) are respected by design — no data is collected to begin with.

## 9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be reflected by the "Last updated" date above and, where appropriate, noted in the App's release notes.

## 10. Contact

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, contact:

- **Developer:** Azimjon Abdurasulov
- **Email:** `azimjondevuz@gmail.com`

title: Privacy Policy for FocusFlow
content:
**Effective Date:** 2026-02-20

Welcome to **FocusFlow** ("we", "our", or "us"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting it through our compliance with this policy.

FocusFlow is designed to help you maintain productivity without sacrificing your privacy. This policy describes the types of information we may collect from you or that you may provide when you use the FocusFlow application.

### 1. Information We Do Not Collect

FocusFlow is a privacy-first application. We **do not** collect, store, or transmit any of your personal data, focus session history, plant garden progress, or notification settings to any external servers.

### 2. Information Stored Locally

All your data is stored locally on your device:
- **Session Data**: Your focus logic, durations, and historical records.
- **Garden Data**: The coins you earn, plants you unlock, and streaks you maintain.
- **Application Preferences**: Your selected sounds, color scheme, and notification preferences.

This data is kept locally utilizing Apple's standard local storage mechanisms (such as SwiftData and UserDefaults). If you decide to delete the app, this local data will be removed from your device.

### 3. Apple Services

FocusFlow utilizes provided Apple Services such as the `UserNotifications` framework to deliver localized reminders to you. These notifications are scheduled and triggered entirely on-device. No notification data is sent to us.

### 4. Third-Party Links

FocusFlow does not contain links to third-party websites or services unless explicitly added by you. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of any third-party websites.

### 5. Children's Privacy

Our application does not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children. Because we do not collect personal data, there is no risk of exposing children's data.

### 6. Changes to Our Privacy Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Since we do not collect contact information, any updates will be reflected within the app or on its respective App Store page. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

### 7. Contact Information

To ask questions or comment about this privacy policy and our privacy practices, contact us at: **[azimjondevuz@gmail.com]**

title: Privacy Policy - Kodo
content:
# Privacy Policy for Kodo

**Effective date: June 12, 2026**

Kodo ("Kodo," "the app," "we," "us," or "our") is a calm heart-rate and wellness companion for iPhone, developed by Azimjon Abdurasulov. This Privacy Policy explains what information the app does and does not handle, how your data stays on your device, and the choices you have.

We built Kodo to be private by design. The short version: **Kodo has no account, no sign-up, and no server. Everything you measure stays on your iPhone.** The longer version is below.

---

## Summary

- **No account, no sign-up, no cloud.** You don't create a profile or log in.
- **All your measurements are stored locally on your device.** We don't run a server, and your data is not uploaded to us.
- **No tracking. No analytics SDKs. No advertising SDKs.** We don't profile you or sell your data.
- **Camera is used only to estimate your heart rate in real time.** No photo, image, or video is ever saved or transmitted.
- **Apple Health is optional and under your control.** You grant or revoke permission, and you can turn it off anytime.
- **Payments are handled by Apple**, not by us. We never see your card details.
- **Suitable for all ages (4+).** We do not knowingly collect data from children.

---

## What This App Is

Kodo helps you understand your heart rate and stress in a calm, simple way. Its features include:

- **Camera-based heart-rate measurement (~30 seconds).** You cover the back camera and flash with your fingertip, and the app reads tiny color changes in your skin to estimate your heart rate, with a live waveform and a signal-quality indicator.
- **Stress score (1–10)** calculated from heart-rate variability (the timing between your heartbeats).
- **Guided box breathing (4-4-4-4)** with a before-and-after comparison.
- **History and trends** of your heart-rate and stress readings, shown as charts.
- **Optional Apple Health sync.**

---

## Information We Collect

**We do not collect your personal information.** Kodo has no user accounts, and we do not operate any servers that receive your data. We do not ask for your name, email, phone number, or any identifier to use the app.

The health-related information the app generates — your heart-rate readings, stress scores, breathing-session results, and the history built from them — is **created and stored only on your device.** We, the developer, never receive it.

### What we specifically do NOT collect or do

- We do **not** collect personal identifiers (name, email, phone, address).
- We do **not** create accounts or user profiles.
- We do **not** upload your measurements, health data, or history to any server.
- We do **not** use third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking SDKs.
- We do **not** track you across apps or websites.
- We do **not** sell, rent, or share your data with anyone.
- We do **not** store or transmit any camera image, photo, or video.
- Kodo does **not** and **cannot** measure blood glucose.

---

## On-Device Storage (Local Data)

All of the data Kodo creates — heart-rate measurements, stress scores, breathing-session comparisons, and your history and trends — is stored **locally on your iPhone** using Apple's on-device database (SwiftData).

Because there is no account and no cloud component, this data:

- Stays on your device,
- Is not synced to us or to any third party, and
- Is accessible only through the app on your device.

---

## Camera Usage

Kodo uses your iPhone's back camera and flash to measure your heart rate using a technique called photoplethysmography (PPG). When you place your fingertip over the camera and flash, the app analyzes subtle changes in color, in real time, to estimate your pulse.

What you should know:

- **Camera frames are processed live, only to compute your heart rate.**
- **No image, photo, or video is ever saved or stored**, on your device or anywhere else.
- **Nothing from the camera is transmitted** off the device.
- **The camera cannot and does not measure blood glucose.**

iOS will ask for your permission before Kodo can access the camera. You can review or change this permission at any time in **Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera** (or in Kodo's entry in the iOS Settings app).

---

## Apple Health (HealthKit)

Apple Health integration is **optional** and only happens with your explicit permission. If you choose to connect Kodo to Apple Health:

- **Kodo writes** your heart rate and heart-rate variability to Apple Health.
- **Kodo reads** heart rate and heart-rate variability from Apple Health.
- **Kodo reads blood glucose on a read-only basis**, solely to display — conditionally — glucose values that **you** have already synced into Apple Health from other apps or devices. **Kodo never measures glucose and never writes glucose to Apple Health.**

Health data accessed through Apple Health is **never shared with us or with any third party**, and it never leaves your device except into your own Apple Health (with your permission).

**You are always in control.** You choose which data categories to allow, and you can change or revoke Kodo's Health permissions at any time in the **Apple Health app → Sharing → Apps → Kodo**, or in the iOS Settings app. Revoking access does not delete data already stored in Apple Health; that remains under your control in the Health app.

We use Apple Health data only to provide the features described in this policy. We do not use it for advertising, and we do not share it for marketing or any other purpose.

---

## No Tracking, Analytics, or Advertising

Kodo contains **no third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking software**. We do not build profiles about you, we do not track your activity across other apps or websites, and the app is ad-free.

---

## Payments and Subscriptions

Kodo offers an optional subscription and purchase called **Kodo Plus**. All payments are processed by **Apple through the App Store (StoreKit)**.

- We do **not** see, receive, or store your credit card or payment details.
- Purchases are charged to your Apple ID and managed in your **App Store account settings**.
- Auto-renewing subscriptions renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The Lifetime option is a one-time, non-renewing purchase.

For details about how Apple handles your purchase information, please see Apple's privacy policy.

---

## Children's Privacy

Kodo is rated **4+** and is suitable for general audiences. We do **not** knowingly collect personal information from children (or from anyone), because the app does not collect personal information at all and has no accounts or servers. All data the app creates stays on the device. If you are a parent or guardian and have questions, please contact us using the details below.

---

## Data Retention and Deletion

Because your data lives **only on your device**:

- **You control retention.** Your measurements and history remain on your iPhone until you delete them.
- **Deleting the app removes its local data.** Uninstalling Kodo deletes the on-device database it created, including your measurements, stress scores, and history.
- **Data written to Apple Health is separate.** If you synced heart rate or heart-rate variability into Apple Health, that data remains in the Apple Health app even after you delete Kodo. You can review and delete it directly in the **Apple Health app**.

Since we never receive your data, there is no copy on our side to request, export, or delete.

---

## International Users

Kodo processes and stores data **locally on your device**, wherever you are located. We do not transfer your data to servers in any country, because we do not operate servers that receive your data. Your data does not leave your device except into your own Apple Health (with your permission) or as handled by Apple for payments. By using the app, you understand that your information is handled as described in this policy.

---

## Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, for example to reflect new features or legal requirements. When we do, we will revise the **Effective date** at the top of this page. Significant changes may also be communicated through the app or the App Store listing. Your continued use of Kodo after an update means you accept the revised policy.

---

## Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact us:

- **Email:** azimjondevuz@gmail.com
- **Developer:** Azimjon Abdurasulov

---

## Wellness Disclaimer

For wellness and informational purposes only. Kodo is **NOT a medical device** and does **NOT measure blood glucose**. Heart rate is estimated from your camera; glucose values are only those you synced from Apple Health — never measured by this app. Not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. Always consult a healthcare professional.

- **Camera-based heart-rate measurement (~30 seconds).** You cover the back camera and flash with your fingertip, and the app reads tiny color changes in your skin to estimate your heart rate, with a live waveform and a signal-quality indicator.
- **Stress score (1–10)** calculated from heart-rate variability (the timing between your heartbeats).
- **Guided box breathing (4-4-4-4)** with a before-and-after comparison.
- **History and trends** of your heart-rate and stress readings, shown as charts.
- **Optional Apple Health sync.**

---

## Information We Collect

**We do not collect your personal information.** Kodo has no user accounts, and we do not operate any servers that receive your data. We do not ask for your name, email, phone number, or any identifier to use the app.

The health-related information the app generates — your heart-rate readings, stress scores, breathing-session results, and the history built from them — is **created and stored only on your device.** We, the developer, never receive it.

### What we specifically do NOT collect or do

- We do **not** collect personal identifiers (name, email, phone, address).
- We do **not** create accounts or user profiles.
- We do **not** upload your measurements, health data, or history to any server.
- We do **not** use third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking SDKs.
- We do **not** track you across apps or websites.
- We do **not** sell, rent, or share your data with anyone.
- We do **not** store or transmit any camera image, photo, or video.
- Kodo does **not** and **cannot** measure blood glucose.

---

## On-Device Storage (Local Data)

All of the data Kodo creates — heart-rate measurements, stress scores, breathing-session comparisons, and your history and trends — is stored **locally on your iPhone** using Apple's on-device database (SwiftData).

Because there is no account and no cloud component, this data:

- Stays on your device,
- Is not synced to us or to any third party, and
- Is accessible only through the app on your device.

---

## Camera Usage

Kodo uses your iPhone's back camera and flash to measure your heart rate using a technique called photoplethysmography (PPG). When you place your fingertip over the camera and flash, the app analyzes subtle changes in color, in real time, to estimate your pulse.

- **Camera frames are processed live, only to compute your heart rate.**
- **No image, photo, or video is ever saved or stored**, on your device or anywhere else.
- **Nothing from the camera is transmitted** off the device.
- **The camera cannot and does not measure blood glucose.**

- **Kodo writes** your heart rate and heart-rate variability to Apple Health.
- **Kodo reads** heart rate and heart-rate variability from Apple Health.
- **Kodo reads blood glucose on a read-only basis**, solely to display — conditionally — glucose values that **you** have already synced into Apple Health from other apps or devices. **Kodo never measures glucose and never writes glucose to Apple Health.**

Health data accessed through Apple Health is **never shared with us or with any third party**, and it never leaves your device except into your own Apple Health (with your permission).

**You are always in control.** You choose which data categories to allow, and you can change or revoke Kodo's Health permissions at any time in the **Apple Health app → Sharing → Apps → Kodo**, or in the iOS Settings app. Revoking access does not delete data already stored in Apple Health; that remains under your control in the Health app.

---

## No Tracking, Analytics, or Advertising

Kodo contains **no third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking software**. We do not build profiles about you, we do not track your activity across other apps or websites, and the app is ad-free.

---

## Payments and Subscriptions

Kodo offers an optional subscription and purchase called **Kodo Plus**. All payments are processed by **Apple through the App Store (StoreKit)**.

- We do **not** see, receive, or store your credit card or payment details.
- Purchases are charged to your Apple ID and managed in your **App Store account settings**.
- Auto-renewing subscriptions renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The Lifetime option is a one-time, non-renewing purchase.

For details about how Apple handles your purchase information, please see Apple's privacy policy.

---

## Children's Privacy

Kodo is rated **4+** and is suitable for general audiences. We do **not** knowingly collect personal information from children (or from anyone), because the app does not collect personal information at all and has no accounts or servers. All data the app creates stays on the device. If you are a parent or guardian and have questions, please contact us using the details below.

---

## Data Retention and Deletion

Because your data lives **only on your device**:

- **You control retention.** Your measurements and history remain on your iPhone until you delete them.
- **Deleting the app removes its local data.** Uninstalling Kodo deletes the on-device database it created, including your measurements, stress scores, and history.
- **Data written to Apple Health is separate.** If you synced heart rate or heart-rate variability into Apple Health, that data remains in the Apple Health app even after you delete Kodo. You can review and delete it directly in the **Apple Health app**.

Since we never receive your data, there is no copy on our side to request, export, or delete.

---

## International Users

Kodo processes and stores data **locally on your device**, wherever you are located. We do not transfer your data to servers in any country, because we do not operate servers that receive your data. Your data does not leave your device except into your own Apple Health (with your permission) or as handled by Apple for payments. By using the app, you understand that your information is handled as described in this policy.

---

## Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, for example to reflect new features or legal requirements. When we do, we will revise the **Effective date** at the top of this page. Significant changes may also be communicated through the app or the App Store listing. Your continued use of Kodo after an update means you accept the revised policy.

---

## Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact us:

- **Email:** azimjondevuz@gmail.com
- **Developer:** Azimjon Abdurasulov

---

## Wellness Disclaimer

For wellness and informational purposes only. Kodo is **NOT a medical device** and does **NOT measure blood glucose**. Heart rate is estimated from your camera; glucose values are only those you synced from Apple Health — never measured by this app. Not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. Always consult a healthcare professional.

Your use of the App is also subject to Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement ("Apple Standard EULA") and the Apple Media Services Terms and Conditions. To the extent these Terms conflict with the Apple Standard EULA with respect to your use of the App obtained from the App Store, the Apple Standard EULA will govern that conflict, except where these Terms are more restrictive, in which case the more restrictive terms apply.

---

## 2. Important Wellness Disclaimer — Kodo Is NOT a Medical Device

**Please read this section carefully. It is one of the most important parts of these Terms.**

> **For wellness and informational purposes only. Kodo is NOT a medical device and does NOT measure blood glucose. Heart rate is estimated from your camera; glucose values are only those you synced from Apple Health — never measured by this app. Not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. Always consult a healthcare professional.**

You expressly acknowledge and agree that:

- The App is intended **solely for general wellness, fitness, and informational purposes**. It is **not** a medical device, is **not** intended for medical use, and has **not** been evaluated, cleared, or approved by any regulatory authority.
- Heart rate is **estimated** from your device's camera using photoplethysmography (PPG) and may be inaccurate. Stress scores derived from heart-rate variability are estimates and should not be treated as clinical measurements.
- The App **does not and cannot measure blood glucose**. Any glucose values displayed are **only** those that you have synced into Apple Health from other apps or devices. The App is read-only with respect to glucose and never measures or records glucose itself.
- The App's outputs are **not** a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Never disregard, avoid, or delay seeking professional medical advice because of anything you read or see in the App.
- You should **always consult a qualified healthcare professional** with any questions about your health, before starting any health, fitness, or breathing program, and before making any decision related to a medical condition.
- **If you think you may have a medical emergency, call your doctor or emergency services immediately.** Do not rely on the App in any situation where inaccurate or incomplete information could lead to injury, death, or property or environmental damage.

You use the App and rely on its outputs entirely at your own risk.

---

## 3. License to Use the App

Subject to your continuous compliance with these Terms, we grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-sublicensable, revocable license to download and install one copy of the App on an Apple-branded iPhone that you own or control, and to use the App for your own personal, non-commercial purposes, all in accordance with the Apple Standard EULA and the usage rules set out in the Apple Media Services Terms and Conditions.

This license does not grant you any ownership interest in the App. All rights not expressly granted to you are reserved by us and our licensors.

---

## 4. Eligibility and Age

The App is rated 4+ and is suitable for general audiences. However, to enter into these Terms and to make purchases, you must be at least the age of majority in your jurisdiction (or have the consent and supervision of a parent or legal guardian who agrees to these Terms on your behalf and is responsible for your use of the App). By using the App, you represent and warrant that you meet these requirements and that all information you provide is accurate.

The App is designed for personal use by adults and by minors under appropriate parental or guardian supervision. It is not intended for use in making any health decision for a minor without the involvement of a qualified healthcare professional.

---

## 5. Subscriptions and Billing (Kodo Plus)

### 5.1 Free Tier

You may use core features of the App at no cost. The free tier includes unlimited heart-rate measurement, stress score, guided breathing, 7-day history, Apple Health sync, and the glucose overlay.

### 5.2 Kodo Plus

"Kodo Plus" is an optional premium offering that unlocks additional features, including 90-day history, a combined heart-rate + glucose timeline, trend analysis, custom reminders, an ad-free experience (the App is ad-free regardless), and data export (planned for version 1.1 and subject to availability). Features may be added, changed, or removed over time.

Kodo Plus is available through the following options:

| Plan     | Price (USD) | Billing                         | Introductory Offer |
| -------- | ----------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| Yearly   | $39.99      | Auto-renewing, yearly           | 7-day free trial   |
| Monthly  | $6.99       | Auto-renewing, monthly          | —                  |
| Lifetime | $69.99      | One-time, non-renewing purchase | —                  |

### 5.3 Auto-Renewal Terms

For auto-renewing subscriptions (Yearly and Monthly):

- Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription **automatically renews** at the then-current price for the same period unless you turn off auto-renewal **at least 24 hours before the end of the current period**.
- Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal at any time by going to your **App Store account settings** after purchase.

### 5.4 Free Trial

The Yearly plan includes a **7-day free trial** introductory offer where eligible. If you do not cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends, your subscription will automatically convert to a paid Yearly subscription and your Apple ID will be charged $39.99. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable. Free-trial eligibility is determined by Apple and may be limited to one per subscription group.

### 5.5 Lifetime Purchase

The Lifetime option is a **one-time, non-consumable purchase** that does not auto-renew and is not a subscription. It unlocks the Kodo Plus features available at the time, for the lifetime of the App on your Apple ID, subject to these Terms and Apple's usage rules.

### 5.6 Payment, Refunds, and Restore

All purchases are processed by **Apple** through the App Store and StoreKit. **We do not receive, see, or store your payment-card data.** Billing, renewals, cancellations, and **refunds** are handled by Apple in accordance with the Apple Media Services Terms and Conditions and applicable App Store policies. To request a refund, contact Apple Support; we are generally unable to issue refunds directly for purchases made through the App Store.

You may restore eligible purchases (such as the Lifetime purchase) by using the restore function within the App, subject to Apple's verification of your Apple ID.

### 5.7 Price Changes

Prices are stated in U.S. dollars; the amount charged in your local currency may vary based on your App Store region and applicable taxes. We may change subscription prices and feature sets. Where required, Apple will notify you of price increases and, where applicable, ask for your consent to continue your subscription before the change takes effect.

---

## 6. Acceptable Use

You agree that you will not, and will not permit anyone else to:

title: Privacy Policy - Koe
content:
# Privacy Policy — Koe

**Effective date:** 12 August 2026
**Last updated:** 12 August 2026

Koe ("the App") is developed and published by **Azimjon Abdurasulov** ("we", "us", "the
Developer"). This Privacy Policy explains what happens to your information when you use Koe.

---

## Summary

**Koe does not collect, transmit, sell, rent, or share any personal data.**

There is no account and no sign-up. The App contains no analytics, no advertising, no trackers,
and no third-party software development kits. Everything you write and record stays on your
device, inside your own private iCloud account, or in a destination you explicitly choose — such
as your Photos library or a share sheet. We have no server that receives your data, and we cannot
see your scripts or your recordings.

---

## 1. Information we do not collect

We do **not** collect, receive, or store any of the following:

- Your name, email address, phone number, or any other contact information
- Account credentials (Koe has no accounts)
- Your scripts, notes, or any text you write in the App
- Your video or audio recordings
- Photos or videos from your Photos library
- Location data
- Contacts, calendars, reminders, or health data
- Device identifiers, advertising identifiers, or usage analytics
- Crash reports or diagnostic logs sent to us

Koe does not include any analytics, attribution, advertising, or crash-reporting service.

---

## 2. Information stored on your device

Koe stores the following **locally on your device**. This information is under your control and is
never transmitted to us.

| What                     | Where it is stored                                       |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| Your scripts             | The App's local database on your device                  |
| Video recordings         | Your Photos library, when you choose to save a recording |
| Audio recordings         | The App's private Documents folder on your device        |
| Preferences and settings | The App's local settings storage on your device          |

Preferences include items such as your reading theme, text size, scroll speed, camera frame rate
and resolution. They contain no personal information.

---

## 3. iCloud sync

If you are signed in to iCloud and have iCloud Drive enabled, your **scripts** are synchronised
across your own Apple devices using Apple's CloudKit service, in the **private database of your
personal iCloud account**.

- This data is stored by Apple under your Apple Account, not by us.
- **We have no access to it.** The Developer cannot read, export, or recover your iCloud data.
- Apple's handling of this data is governed by the
  [Apple Privacy Policy](https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/).
- You can disable this at any time in **Settings → [your name] → iCloud** on your device.

Your **video and audio recordings are not synchronised by the App**. Videos are saved to your
Photos library, which may be backed up by iCloud Photos according to your own Apple settings.

---

## 4. Device permissions

Koe asks for the following permissions. Each is used only for the stated purpose, only while you
are actively using the relevant feature, and always locally on your device.

| Permission            | Why Koe asks for it                                                       |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Camera**            | To show the live preview and record video while you read the teleprompter |
| **Microphone**        | To record audio during video recording and in audio-only mode             |
| **Photos (add only)** | To save a finished video recording to your Photos library                 |

Notes:

- The camera and microphone are active **only during a recording session**. Koe never records in
  the background and never records without you starting a take.
- The Photos permission is **add-only**. Koe can save new recordings to your library; it cannot
  read, browse, or delete your existing photos and videos.
- No camera or microphone data is ever streamed, uploaded, or sent off your device.
- You can revoke any of these permissions at any time in **Settings → Koe** on your device.

---

## 5. AI features

Koe's AI writing features — such as rewriting, shortening, or changing the tone of a script — run
**entirely on your device** using Apple's on-device foundation models.

- Your script text is processed locally on your iPhone.
- **Nothing is sent to us, to Apple, or to any other company** for AI processing.
- These features work offline and require a device that supports Apple's on-device intelligence.
  On devices without support, the feature is simply unavailable.

If a future version of Koe ever introduces an AI feature that requires sending text to a server,
we will update this Privacy Policy before that feature is released, and the App will make it clear
when such a feature is used.

---

## 6. Third-party services

Koe contains **no third-party SDKs**, no advertising networks, no analytics providers, and no
social login. The only external platform involved is Apple, which provides:

- **iCloud / CloudKit** — for syncing your scripts within your own account (Section 3)
- **The App Store** — for distributing the App and processing any purchases

Apple's own privacy practices apply to those services. We receive from Apple only aggregate,
anonymous App Store statistics (such as total download and crash counts), which cannot identify
any individual user.

---

## 7. Purchases

If Koe offers paid features, all purchases are processed by **Apple** through the App Store. We

content:
# Privacy Policy

**Last Updated: February 2026**

At LittleWorld, we take your privacy and your child’s safety very seriously. We do not collect, store, or share any personal information from our users.

### 1. Data Collection
- **Personal Information:** We do not knowingly collect any personal identifiable information from children under the age of 13.
- **CloudKit:** We use Apple's CloudKit to store your learning progress (e.g., stars earned, lessons completed) securely on your private iCloud account. We (the developers) do not have access to this data; it is strictly between you and Apple.
- **Usage Data:** We may collect anonymous, non-personal usage data (such as crash reports or aggregate usage statistics) to help us improve the app's performance and stability. This data is not linked to your identity.

### 2. Advertising
- LittleWorld is a completely ad-free experience. We do not display third-party advertisements to children.

### 3. Subscriptions & Payments
- All financial transactions are handled directly by Apple's App Store. We do not process or store your credit card or payment information.

### 4. Contact Us
- If you have any questions or concerns about our Privacy Policy, please contact us at: azimxxm@gmail.com

title: Privacy Policy for LocalizeKit
content:
**Effective Date:** 2026-04-16

Welcome to **LocalizeKit** ("we", "our", or "us"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting it through our compliance with this policy.

LocalizeKit is a macOS application that automates translation of iOS/macOS localization files. This policy describes the types of information we may collect from you or that you may provide when you use the LocalizeKit application.

### 1. Information We Do Not Collect

LocalizeKit is a privacy-focused application. We **do not** collect, store, or transmit any of your personal data, translation history, or file contents to our own servers.

### 2. Information Stored Locally

All your data is stored locally on your device:
- **Application Preferences**: Your selected translation engine, target languages, output directory settings, and appearance preferences.
- **Translation Cache**: Recently translated strings are cached locally to improve performance and reduce redundant API calls.
- **Security-Scoped Bookmarks**: File system access permissions for your chosen output directories are stored locally using Apple's security-scoped bookmarks.

title: MoodFlix-ios
content:
# MoodFlix — Privacy Policy

*Last updated: 2026-05-01*

This document explains what data the MoodFlix iOS app collects, how it is
used, where it is stored, and what choices you have. Plain English; no
legalese where we can avoid it.

---

## Who we are

MoodFlix is built and operated by **Azimjon Abdurasulov** as an indie
developer. There is no company; there is no marketing department; there
is no third-party analytics SDK. The app is a personal project published
through the Apple Developer Program.

Contact: `azimxxm@gmail.com`

---

## TL;DR

- **No analytics, no tracking, no advertising.**
- All app data lives **on your device** by default.
- The only network requests the app makes are to **The Movie Database
  (TMDB)** at `api.themoviedb.org` and `image.tmdb.org`.
- Your **TMDB token / session is stored in the iOS Keychain on your
  device only** (never synced to iCloud).
- If you sign in to TMDB through the app, **TMDB has its own privacy
  policy** at `https://www.themoviedb.org/privacy-policy`. We don't see
  your TMDB password.

---

## What data does MoodFlix process?

### 1. TMDB authentication tokens (stored on-device only)

When you paste a TMDB v4 Read Access Token, or sign in with your TMDB
account, the app stores the resulting session and token in the iOS
Keychain on your device.

- Storage class: `kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly` —
  the keychain item never roams to other devices via iCloud and is only
  available after the first device unlock following a reboot.
- We never transmit this token to any server other than TMDB itself.
- Sign Out wipes the Keychain entry.

### 2. Watchlist (stored on-device by default)

The titles you save to your Watchlist are stored locally using SwiftData.
If you choose to enable **Sync with TMDB** in Settings, the app pushes
those entries to your TMDB account using the standard TMDB Watchlist API.
Sync is **off by default**.

### 3. Search history (on-device only)

Recent searches are kept in `UserDefaults` on your device so the search
field can offer them as suggestions. They are never transmitted.

### 4. Settings preferences (on-device only)

Your appearance choice (System/Light/Dark), language, content rating cap
(default PG-13), and region preference are stored in `UserDefaults` on
your device. Never transmitted.

### 5. Image cache (on-device only)

The app caches movie/TV poster images to disk so the UI feels fast and
works offline. The cache is governed by `URLCache.shared` (80 MB RAM,
500 MB disk by default). You can clear it from Settings → Storage.

### 6. Notifications (local-only)

If you enable a "Notify me when this title is on Netflix"-style alert,
the app uses iOS's Local Notification system. The alert is delivered by
your iPhone, not by a remote push server. There is no remote push
infrastructure; no APNs token; no notification ID is sent to anyone.

---

## What data leaves your device?

**Only requests to TMDB**, and only when you actively use a feature.
Specifically:

- Searches you type → TMDB search endpoints
- Discover / mood requests → TMDB discover endpoints
- Detail page loads → TMDB movie/tv/person endpoints
- Watchlist sync (if enabled) → TMDB account endpoints
- Sign-in flow → TMDB OAuth (`ASWebAuthenticationSession`)

These requests carry **only the TMDB API token** that authenticates them.
They do not carry your name, email, phone, IP-as-identifier, or any
device-fingerprint header. Standard TLS-protected HTTPS is used in every
case (iOS Network Framework defaults; no `NSAppTransportSecurity`
exemptions).

TMDB's own privacy policy applies to anything you submit to TMDB. See:
`https://www.themoviedb.org/privacy-policy`

---

## What we do NOT do

- We do **not** run any analytics SDK (no Firebase, no Sentry, no
  Mixpanel, no Amplitude, no anything).
- We do **not** show advertising.
- We do **not** track you across other apps or websites.
- We do **not** sell or share your data with third parties (because we
  never have your data in the first place).
- We do **not** target this app at children under 13. The app does not
  fall under COPPA.

---

## App Tracking Transparency

The app does **not** call `requestTrackingAuthorization`. You should never
see the "Ask App not to Track" prompt because the app has nothing to
track.

---

## Permissions

The app may request the following permissions:

- **Notifications** — only when you tap to enable a provider availability
  alert. Used to deliver local-only notifications when a watchlist title
  becomes available on a flagged streaming service.

The app does **not** request: Camera, Microphone, Photos, Contacts,
Calendar, Location, Health, Motion, Bluetooth, or Local Network.

---

## Background activity

The app declares the `Background Fetch` capability and registers a single
background task identifier (`uz.azimxxm.MoodFlix.providerCheck`). When
iOS schedules it (typically every 6 hours, system-controlled), the app
queries TMDB to check whether any watchlist title has become available
on a streaming service the user flagged. If a match is found, a single
local notification is delivered.

This task does not transmit any new data off-device beyond the same
TMDB requests the app would make in the foreground. No analytics ping,
no telemetry, no third-party calls.

---

## Children

MoodFlix is rated 12+ on the App Store. The app does not target users
under 13 and does not collect any data with the intent of identifying
children. The default content cap is PG-13, which can be lifted by an
adult user in Settings.

---

## Your choices

- **Sign Out** clears your TMDB session, access token, and account ID
  from the Keychain.
- **Settings → Storage → Clear Image Cache** removes the on-disk image
  cache.
- **Delete the app** removes the SwiftData store (your local Watchlist),
  the UserDefaults bag, and the Keychain item — i.e., all your data.
- iOS 17+ also provides **Settings → MoodFlix → Reset → Reset Privacy
  Permissions** to revoke the notification grant.

You always have the right to:

- Know what data the app stores about you (this document plus the in-app
  Settings → About screen).
- Delete that data (uninstall the app, or use the choices above).
- Opt out of TMDB Watchlist sync (turn off "Sync with TMDB" in Settings).

---

## Data retention

Because all data lives on your device, retention equals the lifetime of
the app on your device. We have no servers, so we cannot retain anything
about you on our side.

---

## Security

- Tokens are stored in the iOS Keychain, never in plaintext files.
- All network traffic is HTTPS with TLS 1.2+ (system-default).
- The app pins no certificates beyond what iOS provides; this means the
  app benefits from Apple's CT/CRLite/OCSP infrastructure automatically.
- The Universal Link / custom URL scheme handler validates host and path
  strictly to prevent malicious deep-link injection.

---

## Changes to this policy

If this policy ever changes, we will update the "Last updated" date at
the top and (where reasonable) flag the change in the app's release notes.
You should treat the version of this document at the URL on your App
Store listing as authoritative.

---

## Contact

If you have a privacy question, write to:

**`azimxxm@gmail.com`**

---

*This document was last updated on 2026-05-01.*

MoodFlix is rated 12+ on the App Store. The app does not target users
under 13 and does not collect any data with the intent of identifying
children. The default content cap is PG-13, which can be lifted by an
adult user in Settings.

  from the Keychain.

  cache.

  the UserDefaults bag, and the Keychain item — i.e., all your data.

  Permissions** to revoke the notification grant.

- Know what data the app stores about you (this document plus the in-app
  Settings → About screen).
- Delete that data (uninstall the app, or use the choices above).
- Opt out of TMDB Watchlist sync (turn off "Sync with TMDB" in Settings).

---

Because all data lives on your device, retention equals the lifetime of
the app on your device. We have no servers, so we cannot retain anything
about you on our side.

---

## Security

- Tokens are stored in the iOS Keychain, never in plaintext files.
- All network traffic is HTTPS with TLS 1.2+ (system-default).
- The app pins no certificates beyond what iOS provides; this means the
  app benefits from Apple's CT/CRLite/OCSP infrastructure automatically.
- The Universal Link / custom URL scheme handler validates host and path
  strictly to prevent malicious deep-link injection.

the top and (where reasonable) flag the change in the app's release notes.

Store listing as authoritative.

# MoodFlix — Terms of Use

*Last updated: 2026-05-02*

These Terms of Use ("Terms") govern your use of the **MoodFlix** iOS app
("the App"). By downloading, installing, or using the App, you agree to
these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the App.

Plain English. No legalese where we can avoid it.

---

## 1. Who you are agreeing with

The App is built and operated by **Azimjon Abdurasulov** as an indie
developer ("we", "us", "our"). There is no company; the App is a
personal project published through the Apple Developer Program.

Contact: `azimxxm@gmail.com`

---

## 2. License — what you can do

We grant you a **personal, limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable,
revocable license** to install and use the App on Apple-branded devices
that you own or control, in line with Apple's Media Services Terms and
Conditions and the Apple App Store **Standard End User License
Agreement (Standard EULA)** referenced at:

`https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/`

The Standard EULA applies to your use of the App, except where these
Terms explicitly extend or differ from it. In any direct conflict, the
Standard EULA controls for App Store distribution matters; these Terms
control for product-specific behavior described below.

---

## 3. What you may not do

You agree **not** to:

- Reverse-engineer, decompile, disassemble, or attempt to derive source
  code from the App, except as expressly permitted by applicable law.
- Modify, adapt, translate, or create derivative works of the App.
- Remove, obscure, or alter any copyright, trademark, or proprietary
  notices.
- Use the App to violate any law, regulation, or third-party right.
- Use the App to harass, defame, or harm other users of TMDB or any
  third-party service the App integrates with.
- Attempt to bypass, disable, or interfere with security or rate-limit
  features of the App, TMDB, or Apple services.
- Use the App to scrape, mass-download, or republish TMDB content in a
  way that violates the **TMDB API Terms of Use**.
- Use the App in any safety-critical context (medical, aviation, nuclear,
  life-support). The App is for entertainment discovery only.

---

## 4. TMDB attribution and third-party content

The App uses **The Movie Database (TMDB) API** but is **not endorsed,
certified, or otherwise approved by TMDB**. All movie, TV, and person
metadata, images, and ratings displayed in the App are provided by TMDB
and are subject to TMDB's own Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:

- TMDB Terms: `https://www.themoviedb.org/terms-of-use`
- TMDB API Terms: `https://www.themoviedb.org/documentation/api/terms-of-use`
- TMDB Privacy: `https://www.themoviedb.org/privacy-policy`

When you sign in with your TMDB account through the App, **you are
contracting directly with TMDB** for that account. We do not see your
TMDB password and we are not party to your TMDB account agreement.

Streaming-service availability ("watch on Netflix / Apple TV+ /
Disney+", etc.) is sourced from TMDB / **JustWatch** and may be
inaccurate, region-locked, or out of date. We do not control or
guarantee that data.

---

## 5. Your TMDB token and account

The App requires a **TMDB v4 Read Access Token** to load public movie
and TV data. The App ships a default read-only token with `api_read`
scope so you can browse without registering. You may also paste your
own token in **Settings → Replace API token** to use your own quota.

Account-level features (your TMDB Watchlist, ratings, custom lists)
require you to **sign in with your own TMDB account** through the
in-app OAuth flow. You are solely responsible for:

- The security of your TMDB account credentials.
- Compliance with TMDB's terms.
- Any content you create on TMDB through the App.

---

## 6. Privacy

Your privacy matters. The App does not run analytics, does not track
you across apps, and stores all your data on your device. See the full
**Privacy Policy** at `AppStore/PrivacyPolicy.md` (also linked from the
App Store listing and the in-app About screen).

---

## 7. Halal-safe content posture

The App is built with a Muslim audience in mind. By default:

- Every TMDB search and discover request sets `includeAdult: false`.
- The default content rating cap is **PG-13** (you can change this in
  Settings).
- The "Family Time" mood applies an additional family-friendly post-filter.

We make a reasonable effort to filter out adult, gambling, and
alcohol-glorifying content, but **TMDB metadata is provided by
volunteers and is not guaranteed to be perfect**. If you find content
that should be filtered and is not, email `azimxxm@gmail.com` and we
will investigate.

You are responsible for your own viewing choices on third-party
streaming services that the App links out to.

---

## 8. In-app purchases and pricing

The App is currently distributed **free of charge** on the App Store.
There are **no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, and no advertising**
at the time of this document's last-updated date.

If we ever introduce paid features, the price and terms will be shown
clearly in-app **before** any charge is made, and Apple's standard
purchase, refund, and family-sharing rules will apply through your
Apple ID.

---

## 9. Notifications

If you enable provider-availability alerts ("notify me when this title
is on Netflix"), the App uses **iOS Local Notifications**. There is no
remote push infrastructure. You can revoke notification permission at
any time in **iOS Settings → MoodFlix → Notifications**.

---

We may release updates that fix bugs, add features, change behavior,
or remove features. iOS may install updates automatically based on
your device settings.

We may discontinue the App, remove it from the App Store, or stop
maintaining it at any time, with or without notice. Because the App
runs entirely on your device against the public TMDB API, an
abandoned version may continue to work as long as TMDB's API contracts
remain stable.

---

## 11. Disclaimers — read this carefully

THE APP IS PROVIDED **"AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE"**, WITHOUT WARRANTY
OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF **MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR
PURPOSE, AND NON-INFRINGEMENT**. WE DO NOT WARRANT THAT:

- The information shown (titles, ratings, availability, runtimes,

- Defects in the App will be corrected.
- The App is compatible with every iPhone or iOS version.

You use the App **at your own risk**. Nothing in the App is professional
advice of any kind.

---

## 12. Limitation of liability

TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, IN NO EVENT WILL
WE BE LIABLE FOR ANY **INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL,
EXEMPLARY, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES**, INCLUDING LOST PROFITS, LOST DATA,
OR LOSS OF GOODWILL, ARISING OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH YOUR USE
OF — OR INABILITY TO USE — THE APP, EVEN IF WE HAVE BEEN ADVISED OF
THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES.

OUR TOTAL CUMULATIVE LIABILITY FOR ANY CLAIM ARISING OUT OF OR
RELATING TO THESE TERMS OR THE APP WILL NOT EXCEED **THE GREATER OF
(A) THE AMOUNT YOU PAID US FOR THE APP IN THE 12 MONTHS BEFORE THE
EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM, OR (B) USD 5.00**.

# Shaxsiylik Siyosati
**Oxirgi yangilanish: 2025-yil dekabr**

## 1. Kirish
ODDIY HAYOT MCHJ (STIR: 311537836) ("Biz" yoki "Kompaniya") NiyozboshTV ilovasini ("Ilova") taqdim etamiz. Bu Shaxsiylik Siyosati sizning shaxsiy ma'lumotlaringizni qanday yig'amiz, ishlatamiz va himoyalaymizni tushuntiradi. Bizning yuridik manzilimiz: Tashkent viloyati, Yangiyo'l tumani, Paxta MFY, Istiqlol ko'chasi, 230-uy.

## 2. Biz To'playdigan Ma'lumotlar

### 2.1 Avtomatik To'plangan Ma'lumotlar
- **Qurilma Axbori:** Model, operatsion sistema, versiyasi
- **Foydalanish Ma'lumotlari:** Qaysi kanallarni ko'ryapsiz, qancha vaqt o'tkazasiz
- **IP Manzili va Joylashuv:** Xizmatlarni takomlashtirish uchun
- **Logging Ma'lumotlari:** Xatoliklar va xidmat sifatini takomlashtirish

### 2.2 Siz To'ladigan Ma'lumotlar
- Aloqa formasi orqali jo'natgan ismingiz va emailingiz
- Qayd etish yoki hisob yaratish uchun zarur bo'lgan ma'lumotlar

## 3. Ma'lumotlarni Qanday Ishlatamiz
Biz sizning ma'lumotlaringizni faqat quyidagi maqsadlarda ishlatamiz:
- Ilovasini taqdim etish va takomlashtirish
- Xizmatni takomlashtirish va xatolikni aniqlash
- Xavfsizlik va fraud bilan kurashish
- Sizga bildirishnomalar va yangilanishlar jo'natish
- Qonuniy talablarni bajarish

## 4. Ma'lumotlarni Kimga Taqdim Etamiz
Biz sizning shaxsiy ma'lumotlaringizni uchinchi tomonlarga sotmaymiz, savdo qilmaymiz yoki beramiz. Quyidagi holatlardan tashqari:
- Sizning roziligingiz bilan
- Qonuniy talabalar bo'yicha
- Xizmat taqdimchilari (hosting, analytics) bilan - ular shaxsiylik kelishuvi asosida

## 5. Ma'lumotlarning Himoyasi
Biz sizning ma'lumotlarini himoyalash uchun quyidagi choralari qo'llaymiz:
- HTTPS enkriptatsiyasi barcha ulanishlarda
- Xavfsiz serverlar va ma'lumotlar bazalari
- Kirish huquqlarini cheklash
- Muntazam xavfsizlik audit

## 6. Kukilar va Sledlovchi Texnologiyalar
Ilovamiz siz bilan ta'minot berish va takomlashtirish uchun kukilardan foydalanadi. Siz qurilmangizning sozlamalaridan kukilarni o'chirib qo'yishingiz mumkin, lekin bu ba'zi xususiyatlarni ishlamay qolishi mumkin.

## 7. Sizning Huquqlaringiz
Siz quyidagi huquqlaringiz mavjud:
- **Kirish Huquqi:** O'zingiz haqida bizda nima ma'lumot bor, uni bilib olishni
- **To'grilash Huquqi:** Xato ma'lumotlarni to'grilash
- **O'chirish Huquqi:** O'zingiz haqida ma'lumotlarni o'chirish
- **Razi Qilish Huquqi:** Muayyan foydalanishga razi bo'lmaslik
Bu huquqlarni amalashtirish uchun bizga aloqa qiling.

## 8. Faqaroda Foydalanuvchilar
Ilova 13 yoshdan kichik bolalarga mo'ljallanmagan. Biz 13 yoshdan kichik bolalardan shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni rozilik yo'q qasddan to'plamiz. Agar biz shunday ma'lumot topgan bo'lsak, uni darhol o'chiramiz.

## 9. Siyosatdagi O'zgarishlar
Biz ushbu Shaxsiylik Siyosatini istalgan vaqtda o'zgartirish huquqini saqlab qolamiz. Muhim o'zgarishlarga duch kelgan bo'lsa, sizga bildirishnomani jo'natamiz.

## 10. Biz Bilan Bog'lanish
Ushbu Shaxsiylik Siyosati haqida savollaringiz bo'lsa, bizga aloqa qiling yoki email qiling: support@niyozboshtv.uz

## 11. Qonuniy Asoslar
Bu Shaxsiylik Siyosati O'zbekiston Respublikasi qonunlari bilan tuzilgan.
Bu Shaxsiylik Siyosati 2025-yildan amal qila boshladi.

- Xavfsizlik va fraud bilan kurashish

Biz sizning shaxsiy ma'lumotlaringizni uchinchi tomonlarga sotmaymiz, savdo qilmaymiz yoki beramiz. Quyidagi holatlardan tashqari:

- Qonuniy talabalar bo'yicha
- Xizmat taqdimchilari (hosting, analytics) bilan - ular shaxsiylik kelishuvi asosida

- HTTPS enkriptatsiyasi barcha ulanishlarda
- Xavfsiz serverlar va ma'lumotlar bazalari
- Kirish huquqlarini cheklash
- Muntazam xavfsizlik audit

Ilovamiz siz bilan ta'minot berish va takomlashtirish uchun kukilardan foydalanadi. Siz qurilmangizning sozlamalaridan kukilarni o'chirib qo'yishingiz mumkin, lekin bu ba'zi xususiyatlarni ishlamay qolishi mumkin.

Siz quyidagi huquqlaringiz mavjud:
- **Kirish Huquqi:** O'zingiz haqida bizda nima ma'lumot bor, uni bilib olishni
- **To'grilash Huquqi:** Xato ma'lumotlarni to'grilash
- **O'chirish Huquqi:** O'zingiz haqida ma'lumotlarni o'chirish
- **Razi Qilish Huquqi:** Muayyan foydalanishga razi bo'lmaslik
Bu huquqlarni amalashtirish uchun bizga aloqa qiling.

## 8. Faqaroda Foydalanuvchilar
Ilova 13 yoshdan kichik bolalarga mo'ljallanmagan. Biz 13 yoshdan kichik bolalardan shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni rozilik yo'q qasddan to'plamiz. Agar biz shunday ma'lumot topgan bo'lsak, uni darhol o'chiramiz.

## 9. Siyosatdagi O'zgarishlar
Biz ushbu Shaxsiylik Siyosatini istalgan vaqtda o'zgartirish huquqini saqlab qolamiz. Muhim o'zgarishlarga duch kelgan bo'lsa, sizga bildirishnomani jo'natamiz.

## 10. Biz Bilan Bog'lanish
Ushbu Shaxsiylik Siyosati haqida savollaringiz bo'lsa, bizga aloqa qiling yoki email qiling: support@niyozboshtv.uz

Bu Shaxsiylik Siyosati O'zbekiston Respublikasi qonunlari bilan tuzilgan.
Bu Shaxsiylik Siyosati 2025-yildan amal qila boshladi.
