title: Privacy Policy for QRia
content:
# Privacy Policy for QRia

**Last Updated:** January 26, 2026

## 1. Introduction
Welcome to **QRia** ("we," "our," or "us"). We are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information when you use our mobile application.

## 2. Data Collection and Usage
**QRia is designed with privacy as a priority.**

### 2.1. No Personal Data Collection
We do not collect, store, or share any personal identification information (PII) such as your name, email address, phone number, or location data.

### 2.2. Local Processing
All scanning and code generation operations happen locally on your device. Specifically:
- **Camera Data:** The camera is used solely to scan QR codes and barcodes in real-time. We do not record or upload images or video feeds to any server.
- **Scan History:** Your scan history is stored locally on your device. We do not have access to this data.

### 2.3. Third-Party Services
We may use standard Apple services (like iCloud) if you choose to sync your data, which are governed by Apple's own privacy policies.

## 3. Permissions
The app requests the following permissions to function:
- **Camera:** Required to scan QR codes and barcodes. Use of the camera is ephemeral and strictly for scanning.
- **Photo Library:** Required only if you choose to save generated QR codes to your gallery or scan an image from your gallery.

## 4. Children's Privacy
Our Service does not address anyone under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 13.

## 5. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Thus, you are advised to review this page periodically for any changes. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.

## 6. Contact Us
If you have any questions or suggestions about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us at:
**azimjondevuz@gmail.com**

title: Privacy Policy - StorageZen
content:
# Privacy Policy for StorageZen

**Last Updated:** January 4, 2026

At **StorageZen**, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your data when you use our application.

## 1. Data Collection and Usage

### 1.1. Local Processing (Photos & Contacts)
**StorageZen works entirely on your device.**
*   **Photos & Videos:** Algorithms to identify duplicates, screenshots, or similar photos run locally on your iPhone. Your media never leaves your device and is never uploaded to our servers.
*   **Contacts:** Contact analysis (finding duplicates or incomplete contacts) is performed locally. We do not sync or store your contacts on any external server.

### 1.2. No Personal Data Collection
We do not collect, store, or share your personal information (such as your name, email address, or phone number). We do not require you to create an account to use the application.

### 1.3. Analytics
We may use anonymous, aggregated data provided by Apple via App Store Connect (if you have opted-in to share data with developers) to understand usage patterns (e.g., number of active users, retention rates). This data cannot be used to identify you personally.

## 2. Permissions

To function correctly, StorageZen requires access to:
*   **Photo Library:** To find and organize your media.
*   **Contacts:** To help you organize and clean up your address book.

You can revoke these permissions at any time in your device Settings, though some features of the app will no longer function.

## 3. Security
Since all processing happens on your device, your data is protected by the native security features of iOS (FaceID, Passcode, and iOS Sandboxing). We do not have access to your private content.

## 4. Changes to This Policy
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.

## 5. Contact Us
If you have any questions or suggestions about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us at azimjondevuz@gmail.com.

# Terms of Service

**Last Updated:** January 4, 2026

By downloading or using **StorageZen**, these terms will automatically apply to you – you should make sure therefore that you read them carefully before using the app.

## 1. General Usage
StorageZen is a utility application designed to help you organize your device storage.
*   You are responsible for any changes made to your media or contacts.
*   Deleted items are typically moved to the "Recently Deleted" folder on your device (for Photos), giving you a grace period to recover them. However, we are not liable for any permanent loss of data resulting from your use of the app.

## 2. Subscriptions & Purchases

### 2.1. "StorageZen Premium"
StorageZen offers a subscription tailored to your needs (Weekly, Monthly, Yearly) that unlocks full access to all cleaning features.

### 2.2. Payment & Renewal

title: Privacy Policy for StreamNest
content:
# Privacy Policy

**Last Updated: January 4, 2026**

StreamNest ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application.

---

## 1. Information We Collect

### 1.1 Information You Provide
- **Account Information**: Email address, username, and profile photo (if provided)
- **User Content**: Playlists, favorites, and listening preferences
- **Payment Information**: Processed securely through Apple's App Store; we do not store payment details

### 1.2 Automatically Collected Information
- **Device Information**: Device type, operating system, and unique device identifiers
- **Usage Data**: App interactions, listening history, and feature usage
- **Analytics Data**: Crash reports and performance metrics

---

## 2. How We Use Your Information

We use collected information to:
- Provide and improve our music streaming services
- Personalize your listening experience and recommendations
- Process subscriptions and transactions
- Send important service updates and notifications
- Analyze app performance and fix bugs
- Comply with legal obligations

---

## 3. Data Sharing

We do **not** sell your personal information. We may share data with:
- **Service Providers**: Analytics and cloud storage providers bound by confidentiality
- **Legal Requirements**: When required by law or to protect our rights
- **Business Transfers**: In case of merger, acquisition, or asset sale

---

## 4. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures including:
- Encryption of data in transit and at rest
- Secure authentication protocols
- Regular security audits and updates

---

## 5. Your Rights

You have the right to:
- Access your personal data
- Request correction of inaccurate data
- Delete your account and associated data
- Opt-out of marketing communications
- Export your data

To exercise these rights, contact us at **privacy@streamnest.app**

---

## 6. Children's Privacy

StreamNest is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13 years of age.

---

## 7. Third-Party Services

Our app may contain links to third-party services. We are not responsible for their privacy practices. Please review their policies separately.

### Google AdMob
We use Google AdMob to display advertisements in our app. AdMob may use identifiers (such as the Advertising ID) to serve personalized ads based on your interests.
- **Google's Privacy Policy:** [https://policies.google.com/privacy](https://policies.google.com/privacy)
- **Opt-out:** You can opt-out of personalized advertising in your device settings (e.g., "Limit Ad Tracking" on iOS or "Opt out of Ads Personalization" on Android).

---

## 8. Data Retention

We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. You may request deletion at any time.

---

## 9. International Users

Your data may be processed in countries other than your own. By using StreamNest, you consent to such transfers.

---

## 10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes through the app or email.

---

## 11. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:

- **Email**: privacy@streamnest.app
- **Developer**: Azimjon Ergashev

---

*By using StreamNest, you agree to this Privacy Policy.*

title: Privacy Policy for Sukun
content:
**Effective Date:** 2026-04-16

Welcome to **Sukun** ("we", "our", or "us"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting it through our compliance with this policy.

Sukun is a minimal calm companion designed to help you breathe, rest, and find stillness — all without compromising your privacy. This policy describes how we handle your information when you use the Sukun application.

### 1. Information We Do Not Collect

Sukun is a privacy-first application. We **do not** collect, store, or transmit any of your personal data to any external servers. The app operates entirely offline — no network connections, no analytics, no tracking.

We do not collect:
- Personal information (name, email, phone number)
- Location data
- Usage analytics or session history
- Device identifiers or advertising IDs

### 2. Information Stored Locally

All your data is stored locally on your device using Apple's standard storage mechanisms (UserDefaults):

- **Session Preferences**: Your preferred breathing duration (30s, 60s, 120s).
- **Soundscape Settings**: Your selected ambient sound combinations and volume levels.
- **Appearance Preferences**: Your chosen accent color, theme, and background settings.
- **App Settings**: Language preference, haptics toggle, sleep timer configuration, and voice narration preference.
- **Mood Selections**: Your mood check-in responses (Calm, Stressed, Tired, Anxious).

This data never leaves your device. If you delete the app, all local data is permanently removed.

### 3. Audio and Haptics

Sukun uses the device's audio system to play bundled ambient sounds (rain, ocean, forest, white noise, etc.) and the haptic engine for gentle feedback. All audio files are bundled within the app — no streaming or downloading occurs.

### 4. Notifications

Sukun may use Apple's `UserNotifications` framework to deliver breathing session reminders. These notifications are scheduled and triggered entirely on-device. No notification data is sent to us or any third party.

### 5. Third-Party Services

Sukun does not integrate with any third-party services, SDKs, analytics platforms, or advertising networks. The app contains no third-party code that collects data.

### 6. Children's Privacy

Sukun does not collect any personal data from anyone, including children under 13. Because no data is collected or transmitted, the app is safe for users of all ages.

### 7. Changes to Our Privacy Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Any updates will be reflected within the app or on its respective App Store page. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

### 8. Contact Information

To ask questions or comment about this privacy policy, contact us at: **[azimjondevuz@gmail.com]**

title: Privacy Policy - SwipeClean
content:
# Privacy Policy — SwipeClean

**Effective date:** June 9, 2026
**App:** SwipeClean (Photo Cleaner)
**Developer:** Azimjon Abdurasulov
**Contact:** azimjondevuz@gmail.com

## Summary
SwipeClean is built to be private. **All photo analysis happens entirely on your device.** Your photos and videos are never uploaded, transmitted, or shared with us or anyone else. We do not collect personal data, we do not use third-party tracking, and we do not require an account.

## Information We Do NOT Collect
- We do **not** collect, store, or transmit your photos or videos.
- We do **not** collect your name, email, contacts, or location.
- We do **not** use advertising identifiers or cross-app tracking.

## How SwipeClean Uses Your Photo Library
- SwipeClean requests access to your photo library (PhotoKit) **only** to scan, display, organize, and—when you confirm—delete photos and videos you choose.
- All scanning (quality scoring, duplicate detection, blur and screenshot detection) is performed locally on your device using Apple's on-device frameworks (Vision and, on supported devices, Apple Intelligence / Foundation Models).
- Deleting photos uses Apple's PhotoKit. Deleted items move to your "Recently Deleted" album and are permanently removed by the system after 30 days, per iOS behavior. SwipeClean never permanently erases anything outside this standard system flow.
- If you grant **limited** photo access, SwipeClean only ever sees the photos you select.

## Apple Intelligence Features (supported devices)

title: Privacy Policy - Talaba
content:
# Foydalanish shartlari — Talaba / Terms of Service — Talaba

**Oxirgi yangilangan / Last updated:** 2026-06-09
**Ilova / App:** Talaba (`uz.azimxxm.Talaba`)
**Aloqa / Contact:** azimjondevuz@gmail.com

---

## 🇺🇿 O'ZBEKCHA

### 1. Shartlarni qabul qilish
Talaba ilovasini ("ilova") yuklab olib yoki undan foydalanib, siz ushbu Foydalanish shartlariga rozilik bildirasiz. Agar rozi bo'lmasangiz, ilovadan foydalanmang.

### 2. Ilova haqida
Talaba — talabalarga universitet axborot tizimidagi (HEMIS) shaxsiy kabinetiga qulay kirish imkonini beruvchi **mustaqil (norasmiy)** mobil ilova. Ilova **HEMIS yoki biror universitet bilan rasmiy aloqaga ega emas** va ular tomonidan tasdiqlanmagan, homiylik qilinmagan.

### 3. Foydalanish sharti — hisob
Ilovadan foydalanish uchun sizda **amaldagi talaba hisobi** (universitetingiz tomonidan berilgan ID va parol) bo'lishi shart. Hisobingiz maxfiyligi va undan foydalanish uchun siz javobgarsiz. Ilova faqat siz kiritgan ma'lumotlar yordamida sizning o'z kabinetingizga ulanadi.

### 4. Ruxsat etilgan foydalanish
Ilovadan faqat **shaxsiy, ta'limiy maqsadda** va **o'z hisobingiz** doirasida foydalaning. Quyidagilar **taqiqlanadi**:
- boshqalarning hisobiga ruxsatsiz kirishga urinish;
- ilovani teskari muhandislik qilish, buzish yoki universitet serveriga zarar yetkazish;
- ilova orqali olingan ma'lumotlardan noqonuniy maqsadda foydalanish;
- xizmatga ortiqcha yuk berish yoki avtomatlashtirilgan suiiste'mol.

### 5. Ma'lumotlarning aniqligi
Ilovada ko'rsatiladigan barcha ma'lumotlar (jadval, baho, davomat, moliya va h.k.) **universitetingizning HEMIS serveridan** olinadi. Biz bu ma'lumotlarni yaratmaymiz va o'zgartirmaymiz. Ma'lumotlarning to'liqligi yoki aniqligiga kafolat bermaymiz — rasmiy maqsadlar uchun universitetingizning rasmiy manbasiga murojaat qiling.

### 6. Maxfiylik
Ma'lumotlaringiz qanday qayta ishlanishi haqida [Maxfiylik siyosati](privacy.md)ni o'qing.

### 7. Kafolatlar yo'qligi
Ilova "borligicha" (as is) taqdim etiladi. Biz ilova uzluksiz, xatosiz yoki har doim mavjud bo'lishiga kafolat bermaymiz. Universitet serveri o'zgarishi ilova ishiga ta'sir qilishi mumkin.

### 8. Javobgarlikni cheklash
Qonun ruxsat bergan darajada, ilovadan foydalanish natijasida yuzaga kelishi mumkin bo'lgan bilvosita yoki tasodifiy zararlar uchun dasturchi javobgar emas.

### 9. O'zgarishlar
Ushbu shartlar yangilanishi mumkin. Yangilangandan keyin ilovadan foydalanishda davom etish yangi shartlarni qabul qilish hisoblanadi.

### 10. Aloqa
Savollar bo'lsa: azimjondevuz@gmail.com.

---

## 🇬🇧 ENGLISH

### 1. Acceptance of terms
By downloading or using the Talaba app ("the app"), you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

### 2. About the app
Talaba is an **independent (unofficial)** mobile app that gives students convenient access to their personal cabinet in the university information system (HEMIS). The app **is not officially affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by HEMIS or any university**.

### 3. Eligibility — account
To use the app you must have an **active student account** (the ID and password issued by your university). You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for their use. The app connects only to your own cabinet, using the credentials you enter.

### 4. Acceptable use
Use the app only for **personal, educational purposes** and only with **your own account**. The following are **prohibited**:
- attempting to access anyone else's account without authorization;
- reverse-engineering, tampering with, or harming the app or the university server;
- using data obtained through the app for unlawful purposes;
- overloading the service or automated abuse.

### 5. Accuracy of data
All data shown in the app (schedule, grades, attendance, finance, etc.) is fetched from your **university's HEMIS server**. We do not create or modify this data and do not guarantee its completeness or accuracy — for official purposes, refer to your university's official source.

### 6. Privacy
See the [Privacy Policy](privacy.md) for how your data is processed.

### 7. No warranty
The app is provided "as is." We do not guarantee that it will be uninterrupted, error-free, or always available. Changes to the university server may affect the app's operation.

### 8. Limitation of liability

Talaba ilovasini ("ilova") yuklab olib yoki undan foydalanib, siz ushbu Foydalanish shartlariga rozilik bildirasiz. Agar rozi bo'lmasangiz, ilovadan foydalanmang.

### 2. Ilova haqida
Talaba — talabalarga universitet axborot tizimidagi (HEMIS) shaxsiy kabinetiga qulay kirish imkonini beruvchi **mustaqil (norasmiy)** mobil ilova. Ilova **HEMIS yoki biror universitet bilan rasmiy aloqaga ega emas** va ular tomonidan tasdiqlanmagan, homiylik qilinmagan.

### 3. Foydalanish sharti — hisob
Ilovadan foydalanish uchun sizda **amaldagi talaba hisobi** (universitetingiz tomonidan berilgan ID va parol) bo'lishi shart. Hisobingiz maxfiyligi va undan foydalanish uchun siz javobgarsiz. Ilova faqat siz kiritgan ma'lumotlar yordamida sizning o'z kabinetingizga ulanadi.

### 4. Ruxsat etilgan foydalanish
Ilovadan faqat **shaxsiy, ta'limiy maqsadda** va **o'z hisobingiz** doirasida foydalaning. Quyidagilar **taqiqlanadi**:
- boshqalarning hisobiga ruxsatsiz kirishga urinish;
- ilovani teskari muhandislik qilish, buzish yoki universitet serveriga zarar yetkazish;
- ilova orqali olingan ma'lumotlardan noqonuniy maqsadda foydalanish;
- xizmatga ortiqcha yuk berish yoki avtomatlashtirilgan suiiste'mol.

### 5. Ma'lumotlarning aniqligi
Ilovada ko'rsatiladigan barcha ma'lumotlar (jadval, baho, davomat, moliya va h.k.) **universitetingizning HEMIS serveridan** olinadi. Biz bu ma'lumotlarni yaratmaymiz va o'zgartirmaymiz. Ma'lumotlarning to'liqligi yoki aniqligiga kafolat bermaymiz — rasmiy maqsadlar uchun universitetingizning rasmiy manbasiga murojaat qiling.

### 6. Maxfiylik
Ma'lumotlaringiz qanday qayta ishlanishi haqida [Maxfiylik siyosati](privacy.md)ni o'qing.

### 7. Kafolatlar yo'qligi
Ilova "borligicha" (as is) taqdim etiladi. Biz ilova uzluksiz, xatosiz yoki har doim mavjud bo'lishiga kafolat bermaymiz. Universitet serveri o'zgarishi ilova ishiga ta'sir qilishi mumkin.

### 8. Javobgarlikni cheklash
Qonun ruxsat bergan darajada, ilovadan foydalanish natijasida yuzaga kelishi mumkin bo'lgan bilvosita yoki tasodifiy zararlar uchun dasturchi javobgar emas.

### 9. O'zgarishlar
Ushbu shartlar yangilanishi mumkin. Yangilangandan keyin ilovadan foydalanishda davom etish yangi shartlarni qabul qilish hisoblanadi.

### 10. Aloqa
Savollar bo'lsa: azimjondevuz@gmail.com.

### 1. Acceptance of terms
By downloading or using the Talaba app ("the app"), you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

### 2. About the app
Talaba is an **independent (unofficial)** mobile app that gives students convenient access to their personal cabinet in the university information system (HEMIS). The app **is not officially affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by HEMIS or any university**.

### 3. Eligibility — account
To use the app you must have an **active student account** (the ID and password issued by your university). You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for their use. The app connects only to your own cabinet, using the credentials you enter.

### 4. Acceptable use
Use the app only for **personal, educational purposes** and only with **your own account**. The following are **prohibited**:
- attempting to access anyone else's account without authorization;
- reverse-engineering, tampering with, or harming the app or the university server;
- using data obtained through the app for unlawful purposes;
- overloading the service or automated abuse.

### 5. Accuracy of data
All data shown in the app (schedule, grades, attendance, finance, etc.) is fetched from your **university's HEMIS server**. We do not create or modify this data and do not guarantee its completeness or accuracy — for official purposes, refer to your university's official source.

### 6. Privacy
See the [Privacy Policy](privacy.md) for how your data is processed.

### 7. No warranty
The app is provided "as is." We do not guarantee that it will be uninterrupted, error-free, or always available. Changes to the university server may affect the app's operation.

### 8. Limitation of liability
To the extent permitted by law, the developer is not liable for any indirect or incidental damages arising from use of the app.

### 9. Changes
These terms may be updated. Continued use of the app after an update constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

Questions: azimjondevuz@gmail.com.

title: Privacy Policy - Tashkent Metro
content:
# Privacy Policy — Tashkent Metro

**App:** Tashkent Metro (`uz.azimxxm.TashkentMetro`)
**Developer:** azimxxm
**Contact:** azimjondevuz@gmail.com
**Effective date:** June 8, 2026
**Last updated:** June 8, 2026

## Summary

Tashkent Metro is an **offline metro guide**. We do **not** collect, store, sell,
or transmit any personal data. There are no user accounts, no analytics, no
advertising, and no third‑party tracking SDKs. All metro data (lines, stations,
routes, fares, photos) ships inside the app and works without an internet
connection.

## What data we collect

**None.** The app does not collect any personal information. Specifically, it
does **not**:

- Require an account, email, phone number, or login.
- Use analytics, crash reporting, or advertising SDKs.
- Use the Advertising Identifier (IDFA) or track you across apps or websites.
- Send any of your data to our servers — we operate no servers for this app.

This is reflected in our App Store privacy label ("Data Not Collected") and in
the bundled `PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy` manifest (`NSPrivacyTracking = false`, empty
`NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypes`).

## Location

The app may ask for permission to access your location **while you are using the
app** (`When In Use`). This is optional.

- **Purpose:** to show your current position on the metro map so you can find
  the nearest station.
- **Handling:** your location is used **on‑device only**, in real time. It is
  **never stored, logged, or transmitted** off your device, and it is never
  shared with us or any third party.
- **Control:** you can grant or deny this at any time in
  iOS **Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services → Tashkent Metro**.
  Denying it does not affect any other feature of the app.

## Maps

The map screen uses Apple's **MapKit** to draw the underlying city map. To render
the base map, MapKit may load map tiles from Apple over the network. That
exchange is handled entirely by Apple and is governed by
**Apple's Privacy Policy** (<https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/>). We do not
receive, see, or store any of that data. The metro layer drawn on top of the map
(stations, lines, routes) is fully offline and bundled with the app.

## On‑device storage

The app stores only your **preferences** on your device using the standard iOS
mechanism (`UserDefaults`) — for example your chosen interface language and
light/dark appearance. These settings never leave your device.

## Children's privacy

The app is rated **4+** and is safe for all ages. Because we collect no data, we
collect no data from children either. The app contains no user‑generated content,
no messaging, no unrestricted web browsing, and no advertising.

## Third parties

We do not share data with third parties because we do not collect any. The only
platform service involved is Apple (MapKit and iOS), under Apple's own privacy
terms.

## Your rights

Since we hold no personal data about you, there is nothing for us to access,
correct, export, or delete. You remain in full control of the optional location
permission and can revoke it at any time in iOS Settings.

## Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, we will update the "Last updated" date above and publish
the revised version at the same URL. Material changes will be reflected in the
app's release notes.

## Contact

Questions about privacy? Email **azimjondevuz@gmail.com**.

content:
# Privacy Policy for VeoTV Player

**Last Updated: January 2025**

## INTRODUCTION
VeoTV Player ("we," "our," or "the app") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle information when you use our IPTV streaming application.

## INFORMATION WE DO NOT COLLECT
VeoTV Player does not collect, store, transmit, or share any personal information or user data. We do not:
* Track your usage or viewing history
* Collect personal identification information
* Use analytics or tracking services
* Share data with third parties
* Display advertisements or use ad networks
* Require account creation or sign-up

## DATA STORAGE
All data created within VeoTV Player is stored locally on your device:
* IPTV playlist URLs and channel data
* Favorite channels
* App preferences (theme, language, icon)
* Custom stream URLs

This data never leaves your device and is not backed up to our servers (we don't have any servers). If you delete the app, all local data is permanently removed.

## NETWORK USAGE
VeoTV Player connects to the internet only to:
* Fetch IPTV playlists from URLs you provide
* Stream video content from sources you specify
* Load channel logos from playlist metadata

We do not monitor, log, or analyze these connections.

## THIRD-PARTY SERVICES
VeoTV Player does not integrate any third-party services, SDKs, or analytics tools. The app operates entirely independently.

## CHILDREN'S PRIVACY
VeoTV Player does not collect any information from anyone, including children under 13.

## YOUR CONTENT
You are responsible for the IPTV playlists and streams you add to VeoTV Player. We do not provide, suggest, or distribute any content. Ensure you have legal rights to access any content you stream.

## CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally. Updates will be posted within the app and on the App Store.

## CONTACT US
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at:
Email: azimjondevuz@gmail.com

Your privacy is our priority. VeoTV Player is designed to give you complete control over your data - because it never leaves your device.

title: Privacy Policy - VoxNote
content:
# Privacy Policy

**VoxNote: Voice to Text**

Effective date: June 7, 2026

VoxNote ("the App", "we") is developed by Azimjon (azimxxm). This Privacy Policy explains how the App handles your information. The short version: **your data never leaves your device.**

## 1. Data We Collect

**None.** VoxNote does not collect, transmit, store, or share any personal data on external servers. There are no user accounts, no analytics SDKs, no advertising identifiers, and no tracking of any kind.

## 2. How Your Recordings and Transcripts Are Handled

- **Voice recordings** are captured using your device microphone and saved only in the App's private storage on your device.
- **Transcription** is performed entirely on-device using Apple's built-in speech recognition. Your audio is never uploaded to us or to any third-party server for transcription.
- **Transcripts and notes** are stored locally on your device alongside the recordings.
- Deleting a recording or note in the App permanently removes it from your device. We have no copy and no way to recover it.

## 3. Device Permissions

| Permission | Why the App asks |
|---|---|
| Microphone | To record your voice notes. Audio stays on your device. |
| Speech Recognition | To transcribe recordings on-device. No data leaves your device. |

You can revoke these permissions at any time in iOS Settings. The App will continue to work, but recording or transcription will be unavailable until the permission is granted again.

## 4. Purchases

VoxNote Premium is offered as an auto-renewable subscription processed entirely by Apple through the App Store. We do not receive or store your name, payment details, or billing address. Apple's handling of your payment information is governed by [Apple's Privacy Policy](https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/).

## 5. Third Parties

The App contains no third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking frameworks. The App does not share data with third parties — because it does not collect any.

## 6. Children's Privacy

VoxNote does not knowingly collect any data from anyone, including children. Since no data leaves the device, no children's personal information is ever received by us.

## 7. Data Security

Your recordings and transcripts are protected by the security of your own device (device passcode, Face ID / Touch ID, and iOS sandboxing). If you use an iCloud device backup, your local App data may be included in that backup under your own Apple account — this is controlled by you and Apple, not by us.

## 8. Your Rights

Because all data lives only on your device, you are in full control:

- **Access / export** — your recordings and transcripts are available in the App at any time.
- **Deletion** — delete any recording or note in the App, or delete the App itself to remove all of its data.

## 9. Changes to This Policy

If the App's data practices ever change (for example, if a future version adds an online feature), this policy will be updated and the effective date revised before such a feature ships.

## 10. Contact

Questions about this policy:

- Email: azimjondevuz@gmail.com

We grant you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to use the App on Apple-branded devices that you own or control, in accordance with these Terms and Apple's App Store Terms of Service.

VoxNote lets you record voice notes and transcribe them to text on your device. Recordings and transcripts are stored locally on your device only — see our [Privacy Policy](https://azimxxm.uz/voxnote/privacy).

## 3. Free Tier and VoxNote Premium

The free version of the App includes a limited number of recordings and limited transcription length. **VoxNote Premium** removes these limits and is offered as an auto-renewable subscription with weekly, monthly, and yearly plans. Current prices are always shown in the App before purchase.

### Subscription terms

- Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, at the price shown at purchase time.
- You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your device settings: **Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions**, or in the App Store app.
- Cancelling stops future renewals; you keep Premium access until the end of the already-paid period.
- If offered, any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

### Refunds

Purchases are processed by Apple. Refund requests are handled by Apple, not by us — visit [reportaproblem.apple.com](https://reportaproblem.apple.com) or contact Apple Support.

## 4. Your Content

You own your recordings and transcripts. We claim no rights over them and — since they never leave your device — we have no access to them. You are solely responsible for the content you record, including obtaining any consent required by applicable law before recording other people.

## 5. Acceptable Use

You agree not to:

- use the App to record any person without consent where consent is required by law;
- use the App for any unlawful purpose;
- reverse engineer, decompile, or attempt to extract the source code of the App, except where permitted by law;
- resell, rent, or redistribute the App.

## 6. Transcription Accuracy

Transcription is performed by on-device speech recognition and is provided **as is**. Accuracy depends on audio quality, language, accent, and background noise. Do not rely on transcripts as the sole record for medical, legal, financial, or other critical purposes — always verify against the original recording.

## 7. Data Loss

All data is stored locally on your device. We cannot recover recordings or transcripts that are deleted, lost due to device damage or loss, or removed when the App is uninstalled. You are responsible for your own device backups (e.g., iCloud backup).

The App is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement. We do not warrant that the App will be uninterrupted or error-free.

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, we shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for any loss of data, arising out of or related to your use of the App. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount you paid for the App in the twelve months preceding the claim.

These Terms remain in effect until terminated. We may terminate the license if you breach these Terms. You may terminate at any time by deleting the App. Sections 4, 6–9 survive termination.

We may update these Terms from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by a new effective date at the top of this page. Continued use of the App after changes take effect constitutes acceptance.

These Terms are between you and the developer, not Apple. Apple has no obligation to provide maintenance or support for the App and is not responsible for any product claims, warranties, or legal compliance. Apple is a third-party beneficiary of these Terms and may enforce them against you.

title: Privacy Policy - WallCam
content:
# Privacy Policy for WallCam

**Last updated:** January 4, 2026

At WallCam, we prioritize your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your data when you use our mobile application ("WallCam").

## 1. Information We Collect

### 1.1 Personal Information
We do not collect personal information that identifies you (such as your name, address, or phone number) unless you voluntarily provide it to us, for example, when you contact us for support.

### 1.2 Usage Data
We may collect non-personal data about how you interact with the app. This includes:
- Device information (e.g., model, operating system version).
- App usage statistics (e.g., features used, session duration).
- Crash logs and diagnostic data to help us improve app stability.

### 1.3 Permissions
To provide its core functionality, WallCam may request access to certain features on your device:
- **Camera:** Required to capture photos and videos directly within the app.
- **Photo Library:** Required to save captured media to your device or to import existing media.
- **Microphone:** Required to record audio if you are capturing videos.

You can manage these permissions at any time in your device settings.

## 2. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information for the following purposes:
- To provide and maintain the WallCam app.
- To improve and optimize the app's performance and user experience.
- To detect, prevent, and address technical issues.
- To provide customer support when you contact us.

## 3. Data Sharing and Third Parties

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal identification information to others. We may share generic aggregated demographic information not linked to any personal identification information regarding visitors and users with our business partners, trusted affiliates, and advertisers for the purposes outlined above.

We may use third-party services (e.g., analytics providers) that collect, monitor, and analyze this type of information in order to increase our app's functionality. These third-party service providers have their own privacy policies addressing how they use such information.

### Google AdMob
We use Google AdMob to display advertisements in our app. AdMob may use identifiers (such as the Advertising ID) to serve personalized ads based on your interests.
- **Google's Privacy Policy:** [https://policies.google.com/privacy](https://policies.google.com/privacy)
- **Opt-out:** You can opt-out of personalized advertising in your device settings (e.g., "Limit Ad Tracking" on iOS or "Opt out of Ads Personalization" on Android).

## 4. Data Security

We value your trust in providing us your Personal Information, thus we are striving to use commercially acceptable means of protecting it. But remember that no method of transmission over the internet, or method of electronic storage is 100% secure and reliable, and we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

## 5. Children's Privacy

WallCam does not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under the age of 13. If we discover that a child under 13 has provided us with personal information, we effectively delete this from our servers. If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so that we will be able to do necessary actions.

## 6. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Thus, you are advised to review this page periodically for any changes. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page. These changes are effective immediately after they are posted on this page.

## 7. Contact Us

If you have any questions or suggestions about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us at:

**Email:** azimjondevuz@gmail.com

At WallCam, we prioritize your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your data when you use our mobile application ("WallCam").

## 1. Information We Collect

### 1.1 Personal Information
We do not collect personal information that identifies you (such as your name, address, or phone number) unless you voluntarily provide it to us, for example, when you contact us for support.

### 1.2 Usage Data
We may collect non-personal data about how you interact with the app. This includes:
- Device information (e.g., model, operating system version).
- App usage statistics (e.g., features used, session duration).
- Crash logs and diagnostic data to help us improve app stability.

### 1.3 Permissions
To provide its core functionality, WallCam may request access to certain features on your device:
- **Camera:** Required to capture photos and videos directly within the app.
- **Photo Library:** Required to save captured media to your device or to import existing media.
- **Microphone:** Required to record audio if you are capturing videos.

You can manage these permissions at any time in your device settings.

## 2. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information for the following purposes:
- To provide and maintain the WallCam app.
- To improve and optimize the app's performance and user experience.
- To detect, prevent, and address technical issues.
- To provide customer support when you contact us.

## 3. Data Sharing and Third Parties

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal identification information to others. We may share generic aggregated demographic information not linked to any personal identification information regarding visitors and users with our business partners, trusted affiliates, and advertisers for the purposes outlined above.

We may use third-party services (e.g., analytics providers) that collect, monitor, and analyze this type of information in order to increase our app's functionality. These third-party service providers have their own privacy policies addressing how they use such information.

### Google AdMob
We use Google AdMob to display advertisements in our app. AdMob may use identifiers (such as the Advertising ID) to serve personalized ads based on your interests.
- **Google's Privacy Policy:** [https://policies.google.com/privacy](https://policies.google.com/privacy)
- **Opt-out:** You can opt-out of personalized advertising in your device settings (e.g., "Limit Ad Tracking" on iOS or "Opt out of Ads Personalization" on Android).

## 4. Data Security

We value your trust in providing us your Personal Information, thus we are striving to use commercially acceptable means of protecting it. But remember that no method of transmission over the internet, or method of electronic storage is 100% secure and reliable, and we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

## 5. Children's Privacy

WallCam does not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under the age of 13. If we discover that a child under 13 has provided us with personal information, we effectively delete this from our servers. If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so that we will be able to do necessary actions.

## 6. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Thus, you are advised to review this page periodically for any changes. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page. These changes are effective immediately after they are posted on this page.

## 7. Contact Us

If you have any questions or suggestions about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us at:

**Email:** azimjondevuz@gmail.com
